lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gills, organized into roughly vertical columns of 5-7 blobs each across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs to form a structured lattice or anchor-node pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent horizontal ridge feature running along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition from light dorsal pixels to shaded lateral pixels.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of approximately 4-6 visible high-luminance blobs on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced notch or irregular indentation on the anterior dorsal edge of the first dorsal fin. Two elongated, high-luminance biological appendages (likely remoras) are attached near the posterior base of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from large, organized grid-patterned blobs on the flank to a dense, stochastic distribution of significantly smaller punctate clusters in the cephalic region.
